title: Idle Idiots – my gross-humor idle auto-battler RPG, looking for feedback
author: pun1sh3-r
selftext:
Hey guys!

I made this game for people who, like me, love incremental games, auto battlers, Diablo 4, and Path of Exile.

I’m a senior frontend developer, and I use Claude to help with design and some of the content. The game mixes my own ideas with inspiration from games I love.

It has leaderboards, a snapshot-based PvP arena, loads of achievements, ridiculous legendary items, and plenty of other fun stuff.

Here’s the link: [https://idleidiots.pages.dev](https://idleidiots.pages.dev/)

Just wanted to share it with you—if you give it a try, I’d love to hear what you think!
